cluster_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE cluster

idp_sso_target_url.description: The identity provider URL to which the authentication request should be sent

idp_slo_target_url.description: The identity provider URL to which the logout request should be sent

idp_cert.description: The certificate provided from the identity provider when setting up the relationship

issuer.description: The URL for the Illumio login server. Some identity providers might need this to establish the identity of the service provider requesting authentication.

consumer_service_url.description: The Illumio login server URL at which the SAML authentication assertion should be received

consumer_logout_url.description: The Illumio login server URL at which the SAML logout assertion should be received

name_identifier_format.description: Describes the format of the username required by the Illumio login server

authn_context.description: The URI of the authentication context class you want the identity provider to use to authenticate user, with possible values being NULL (unspecified) or urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:ac:classes:PasswordProtectedTransport

force_authn.description: Defines whether or not the identity provider should force re-authentication of the user, even if the user has still a valid session

sign_authn_request.description: Defines whether or not PCE should sign saml authN request to IdP; default is false

pce_signing_cert.description: The certificate generated by the PCE that needs to be uploaded to the IdP; this certificate will be used by the IdP to verify the signature of authN request if sign_authn_request is enabled

created_at.description: Timestamp when SAML configuration was first created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when SAML configuration was last updated

username.description: The username which created this SAML configuration
The username which last updated this SAML configuration
